content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a simple issue. I am using two [product_name] modules, both connected via Ethernet in a master/master configuration. I want to set up a function so that if the Ethernet connection is lost, a specific output or marker is activated. I tried to use the diagnostic marker, but it does not show any change when connecting or disconnecting. Thank you for any help!
I would create custom monitoring logic. This way, you can not only check the Ethernet connection status but also monitor if your partner [product_name] module is still functioning.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are having trouble setting up reliable detection for Ethernet connection loss between two [product_name] modules in a master/master setup. The diagnostic marker feature does not indicate changes during Ethernet disconnection, making it difficult to trigger actions. This highlights challenges in monitoring network status and transparency in multi-module systems.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] system to accurately identify Ethernet connection loss and activate an output, relying on the diagnostic marker feature for network status monitoring.
